limitations: The affine-forcing step is binary, the threshold r<=3t-4 is sufficient rather than claimed optimal, and the theorem does not settle existence of the length-11 size-2^7 3-PIR code; it proves only that any such code must have a nonlinear associated code. Originality is to the best of our knowledge, with residual risk from equivalent results under unrelated Boolean-function or coding terminology.
provenance: A structural theorem showing that, at sufficiently low redundancy, any binary t-PIR encoder onto a linear associated code is affine-equivalent to a linear t-PIR encoder, with an application to the open length-11 size-2^7 binary 3-PIR case.
record_title: Low-redundancy linearization of nonlinear binary PIR encoders
